title: 第五章 永恒烈阳教会第六章 真言蔷薇
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工
content_zh:
;;
“你有什么计划吗？”坐在沙发上的林奇看着已经冷静下来的伊莱娜问道。
“我打算明天去墨尔家族看一下。”伊莱娜看着他说道。
“放心，我会很小心的。别小看我啊，我好歹也是观星者。”
群星序列，序列9观星者。
“好吧，明天我去罗兰庄园看能不能帮你打听到有用的情报，晚上在这里集合。”林奇叹了一口气。
林奇帮伊莱娜整理出了自己的卧室，他去了之前父亲睡的主卧。
躺在床上的他突然想到好像还有新的系统消息没看。
正想着半透明的屏幕就出现在了他的眼前。
【恭喜您！成功达成条件成为**途径：浪漫序列：序列9牵线人】
【解锁主线任务：浪漫终章】
1、序列9牵线人lv10lv10（已达成）
2、收集三份中序列神圣途径神秘物质（未达成）
3、理解亲情（未达成）
达成以上三个条件可以解锁序列8平衡舞者。
主线任务已完成！
奖励发放：1500经验值、50银币、伊莱娜好感度。
主线任务发布：
请帮助伊莱娜搞清贫民区黑帮黑恶会追杀她的原因。
任务奖励：2000经验值、30金币、c级禁物焰火。

我靠？看着眼前新出现的两个任务林奇陷入了兴奋。
升到下个序列居然不需要超凡知识！
因为系统面板的存在，林奇明明算作本地人，却能享受如玩家一般的福利。
如果是本地人想要升到高序列就必须拥有超凡知识，而玩家只需要经验值足够并完成转职任务就可以来到下个序列。
林奇属于玩家！
他只需要升到足够等级然后完成系统的那两个任务就能升到序列8。
绝对的好消息啊！
神圣途径的神秘物质还算好弄，只要有钱就能买到，但是这个理解亲情...
怎么理解？
他上一世就是一个孤儿，这一世穿过来的时候双亲也去世了。
这不是在难为人呢吗？
再看下一个任务，更是非常棒棒。
黑恶会只是一个全是普通人的黑帮组织，直接冲进去对他们一顿殴打就能拿到一个禁物！

"Do you have any plans?" Lynch, who was sitting on the sofa, asked Elena, who had calmed down.
"I plan to go to the Moore family to have a look tomorrow." Elena looked at him and said.
"Don't worry, I will be very careful. Don't underestimate me, I am also a stargazer after all."
Star sequence, sequence 9 stargazer.
"Okay, tomorrow I will go to Roland Manor to see if I can help you get any useful information. I will meet here in the evening." Lynch sighed.
Lynch helped Elena tidy up her bedroom, and he went to the master bedroom where his father slept.
While lying on the bed, it suddenly occurred to him that there seemed to be new system messages that he had not read.
Just as he was thinking about it, a translucent screen appeared in front of him.
【Congratulations! Successfully meet the conditions to become the **Path: Romance Sequence: Sequence 9 Matchmaker]
[Unlock the main mission: Romantic Final Chapter]
1. Sequence 9 matchmaker lv10lv10 (achieved)
2. Collect three copies of the mysterious substances of the sacred path in the medium sequence (not achieved)
3. Understand family affection (not yet achieved)
Meeting the above three conditions can unlock the Sequence 8 Balance Dancer.
The main mission has been completed!
Reward distribution: 1500 experience points, 50 silver coins, and Elena's favorability.
Main mission release:
Please help Elena figure out why the gangsters in the ghetto are after her.
Mission reward: 2000 experience points, 30 gold coins, C-level forbidden fireworks.
Holy shit? Looking at the two new tasks that appeared in front of him, Lin Qi fell into excitement.
No extraordinary knowledge is required to advance to the next level!
Because of the existence of the system panel, Lin Qi is obviously a local, but he can enjoy the same benefits as a player.
If a local wants to advance to a high sequence, he or she must have extraordinary knowledge, and players only need to have enough experience points and complete job transfer tasks to move to the next sequence.
Lynch belongs to players!
He only needs to reach a sufficient level and complete the two tasks of the system to be promoted to Sequence 8.
Absolutely good news!
The mysterious substances of the sacred path are relatively easy to get, as long as you have money, you can buy them, but this understanding of family ties...
How to understand?
He was an orphan in his last life, and his parents also passed away when he passed through this life.
Isn't this making things difficult for others?
Looking at the next mission, it is even more awesome.
The Black Evil Society is just a gang organization made up of ordinary people. If you just rush in and beat them up, you can get a forbidden object!
